title: Maul
summary: A martial maul dealing 2d6 Bludgeoning before adding Strength.

fields.Damage: 2d6 Bludgeoning plus Strength modifier. Martial, two-handed, heavy, dippable, 5 ft melee.
fields.Tenacity: Main hand. After a missed melee attack, spend your Reaction to deal Bludgeoning equal to your Strength modifier, minimum 1. The missed weapon action’s special effect does not apply.
fields.Backbreaker: With proficiency, Action once per Short Rest. Make a melee attack against a Large or smaller creature for 1d4 + attack ability modifier Bludgeoning. On hit, a Strength save against weapon-action DC prevents Prone for 2 turns.
fields.Concussive Smash: With proficiency, Action once per Short Rest. Make a melee weapon attack. On hit, Constitution save against the higher of your spell save DC or weapon-action DC + 2 prevents Dazed for 2 turns. Dazed removes the Dexterity bonus to AC, imposes disadvantage on Wisdom saves, and blocks reactions that spend a Reaction. Help can end it.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
